KPlugin.Name: Window Border
KPlugin.Description: Adds a "Window Border" submenu to the window menu (Alt+F3 or right-click on the titlebar) that gives an application the native KWin/Breeze window border
KPlugin.Description[zh_CN]: 在窗口菜单（Alt+F3 或标题栏右键）里增加“窗口边框”子菜单：给当前应用加/去 KWin/Breeze 原生边框，并可在设置面板里维护启用的应用列表
